mapper.select: SELECT i.strategy_id, s.instance_id FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id JOIN quant_strategy_symbol b ON b.id=i.strategy_symbol_id JOIN quant_symbol q ON q.id=b.symbol_id WHERE i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND s.position_id=#{positionId} AND s.position_cycle_key=#{cycleKey} AND q.symbol=#{symbol} AND s.direction=#{direction}
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_protection_order SET status='WORKING', exchange_order_id=COALESCE(exchange_order_id, #{exchangeOrderId}), executed_quantity=CASE WHEN #{executedQuantity} IS NULL THEN executed_quantity WHEN executed_quantity IS NULL OR executed_quantity < #{executedQuantity} THEN #{executedQuantity} ELSE executed_quantity END, updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND credential_id=#{credentialId} AND client_order_id=#{clientOrderId} AND (exchange_order_id IS NULL OR exchange_order_id=#{exchangeOrderId}) AND status IN ('NEW','ACCEPTED','PAPER_ACCEPTED','PREPARED','DISPATCHING','PENDING','UNKNOWN','CANCEL_FAILED')
